description_zh: 创建一个四层加速应用
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-transport-layer-application --site-id 1234560000 --record-name aaa.example.com --rules Comment=Test EdgePort=80 SourceType=ip ClientIPPassThroughMode=SPP Protocol=TCP SourcePort=80 Source=1.1.1.1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTransportLayerApplication

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID. The site must be activated
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。需要注意的是站点必须是已激活的站点
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the Layer 4 application
parameters.name: record_name

fields.help_en:
The client IP pass-through protocol. Valid values:
off: disabled.
PPv1: PROXY Protocol v1. Supports client IP pass-through for TCP.
PPv2: PROXY Protocol v2. Supports client IP pass-through for TCP and UDP.
SPP: Simple Proxy Protocol. Supports client IP pass-through for UDP
fields.help_zh:
客户端IP传递协议，支持：
off: 不传递。
PPv1: PROXY Protocol v1协议，支持TCP协议的客户端IP传递。
PPv2: PROXY Protocol v2协议，支持TCP和UDP协议的客户端IP传递。
SPP: Simple Proxy Protocol协议，支持UDP协议的客户端IP传递
fields.name: client_ip_pass_through_mode

fields.help_en:
The edge port. The following formats are supported:

A single port, such as 80.
A port range, such as 81-85, which represents ports 81, 82, 83, 84, and 85.
A combination of ports and port ranges separated by commas, such as 80,81-85,90, which represents ports 80, 81, 82, 83, 84, 85, and 90.

Edge ports within a single rule and across multiple rules must not overlap
fields.help_zh:
边缘端口。支持：

单个端口，例如80。
端口范围，例如 81-85，代表端口 81、82、83、84、85。
端口和端口范围组合，端口、端口范围之间用逗号分隔，例如80,81-85,90，代表端口80、81、82、83、84、85、90。

单个规则的边缘端口以及多个规则之间的边缘端口不允许重叠
fields.name: edge_port

fields.help_en:
The forwarding rule protocol. Valid values:

TCP: TCP protocol.
UDP: UDP protocol
fields.help_zh:
转发规则协议，取值：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The specific value of the origin, which must match the origin type
fields.help_zh: 源站具体的值，需要与源站类型相匹配
fields.name: source

fields.help_en:
Origin Server Port. The following formats are supported:

A single port. When Origin Server Port is a single port, any valid edge port combination is supported.
A port range. Origin Server Port can be set to a port range only when the edge port is also a port range, and the range size must match the edge port range. For example, if the edge port is 90-93, you cannot set Origin Server Port to 81-85 because Origin Server Port range size is 5 while the edge port range size is 4, which is inconsistent
fields.help_zh:
源站端口。支持：

单个端口，当源站端口为单个端口时，支持任意合法的边缘端口组合。
端口范围，仅当边缘端口为端口段时，源站端口才允许设置为端口范围且范围大小需要与边缘端口一致。例如边缘端口若为90-93，则不允许将源站端口设置为81-85，因为源站端口范围为5，边缘端口范围为3，两者不一致
fields.name: source_port

fields.help_en:
The origin type. Valid values:
ip: IP address.
domain: domain name.
OP: origin IPAM pool.
LB: load balancing
fields.help_zh:
源站类型，支持：
ip: IP。
domain: 域名。
OP: 源地址池。
LB: 负载均衡器
fields.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The IP access rule switch. When enabled, IP access rules in WAF take effect for the Layer 4 application. Valid values:

on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
IP访问规则开关，开启后，WAF中的 IP访问规则对四层应用生效。

on: 开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: ip_access_rule

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable IPv6. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
Ipv6开关，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: ipv6

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable network access optimization for the Chinese mainland. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启中国大陆网络接入优化，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: cross_border_optimization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable static IP. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启固定IP，默认关闭。取值范围：

on: 开启。
off: 关闭
parameters.name: static_ip

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable keep-alive protection. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启连接保持防护，默认关闭。取值范围：

on: 开启。
off: 关闭
parameters.name: keep_alive_protection
